kind: LLM Accuracy 0.7.2 explore-first ambiguity reminder: paired live screens against 0.7.1; raw-free aggregates
fixture: One synthetic signups.csv generated deterministically by scripts/eval_ambiguity_explore.py; no customer or company data. No prompt, answer or file content is recorded here.

method.scoring: Every reply was read in full and each figure it stated was recomputed from the fixture.
method.opening_rubric: Conditional: the opening frames the figure as depending on a definition and the reply asks the user to choose. Committed: the first sentence states one figure as the answer.

known_limits: Screens only: one synthetic fixture, one vague and one precise wording, n=1-3 per cell; no powered comparison.
Slip counts are too small to compare versions; the screen does not show that answers become more accurate.
The new-count pattern needs a 'How many new ...' opening with a verb such as 'did we get' or 'were there'; other wordings are not recognised yet.
Opening with a question is the intended behaviour change, not a measured user benefit.
The fixture has an unseeded quirk: 18 accounts subscribe before they sign up. It does not change any count; some replies flagged it.
Desktop Chat and Cowork were not rerun for this patch.
